purpose: Replace self-referential progress claims with sourced comparable competitor evidence and explicit no-head-to-head status
scope: Development-only public source comparison; no independent competitor evaluation completed

source_cards.note: Not equivalent to full source documents, scholarly knowledge graphs or qualified working implementations

alternatives.name: PaperQA2
alternatives.documented_capability: Local full-text document ingest, scientific literature QA, agentic evidence retrieval/reranking and cited answers
alternatives.atlas_gap: Our Academic answer and citation correctness on original passages is not independently scored
alternatives.reusability: Already trialed retrieval; full inference previously timed out
alternatives.required_test: Equal original PDF/source set, 15-30 blind scoped claims including negation, unsupported causal interpretation, retractions and numeric source-table claims

alternatives.name: OpenScholar
alternatives.documented_capability: Scientific literature synthesis grounded in a published 45-million-paper datastore and ScholarQABench expert-written questions
alternatives.atlas_gap: No demonstrated comparable multi-paper synthesis, citation accuracy or expert adjudication
alternatives.reusability: Research benchmark; avoid independently rebuilding corpus/LLM stack
alternatives.required_test: Shared allowed paper corpus; expert-adjudicated open-ended synthesis, citation quotation accuracy, source support and false-citation rate

alternatives.name: Elicit
alternatives.documented_capability: Research Agent for literature discovery/data extraction plus guided systematic-review workflows and PRISMA outputs
alternatives.atlas_gap: No comparable complete systematic-review workflow demonstrated for Atlas
alternatives.reusability: External service benchmark, not an open-source backend
alternatives.required_test: Same investigator query, source access, inclusion-exclusion criteria, extraction-field correctness, evidence source tracing, cost/time

alternatives.name: OpenAleph
alternatives.documented_capability: Investigative document and entity indexing plus private/public cross-dataset entity comparison with reviewer confirmation
alternatives.atlas_gap: Frozen Practical 57-card map lacks real sanitized Nocturnal publication and comparable investigation workflow proof
alternatives.reusability: FollowTheMoney ontology compatibility; don't copy identity/review engine
alternatives.required_test: Two authorized public cases; entity disambiguation precision, original provenance, timeline corrections, false associations, abstention and reviewer time

alternatives.name: OCCRP Aleph Pro
alternatives.documented_capability: Research records, entity search across datasets, investigative memory and public source fetching
alternatives.atlas_gap: No comparable released dataset breadth or journalistic investigator evaluation
alternatives.reusability: External user-facing benchmark with access limitations; do not claim same data access
alternatives.required_test: Fair source-matched public-only investigation tasks, including false-name merges, missing documents and chain-of-custody

alternatives.name: ecosyste.ms Science
alternatives.documented_capability: Scientific repository discovery, science scores, academic references, package/dependency relationships
alternatives.head_to_head_scope: 398/1287 exact source identity overlap only (not task outcome or scientific accuracy)
alternatives.atlas_gap: Our repo survey covers many entries outside Science, but no statistically verified comparative functionality qualification advantage
alternatives.reusability: Optional package/dependency context, fail back to GitHub original
alternatives.required_test: Twenty or more matched/unmatched task-specific repos, pinned commits, genuine functionality replays, false-positive qualification rate, evidence time

alternatives.name: Open Research Knowledge Graph
alternatives.documented_capability: Tabular comparisons of research contributions to a question with structured scholarly graph
alternatives.atlas_gap: Our Academic graph is not independently compared on real scientific comparison questions; other maps not matched functionality
alternatives.reusability: Read-only v2 paper metadata integration working; paper claims still unvalidated
alternatives.required_test: Twenty real research questions; match paper sources, original-study result granularity and contradictions with reviewer-scored accuracy

alternatives.name: ChatGPT Deep Research
alternatives.documented_capability: Plan, research and synthesize complex source-grounded reports with citations
alternatives.atlas_gap: No end-to-end comparison showing Atlas produces better evidence-qualified problem-to-research-to-working-tool conclusions
alternatives.reusability: Generic product baseline with equal permitted source access
alternatives.required_test: Same source-constrained real problem and exact evidence, trace actionable output and inappropriate confident claims, report latency and user value

next_decision: Run an independently labelled, source-matched practical/academic/implementation head-to-head before stating parity/superiority. Focus reused models and evidence/negation validation, not more databases.
limits: Published incumbent performance is not directly comparable to our archived development probes
Capability descriptions are sourced from maintainers/papers and not independently reproduced here
Current Atlas original paper/source SHA match does not prove claim entailment
Nonzero cards or CI passes alone are not market competitiveness
